items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Now, when I met him in Sebastian's Cotton Club, he was working with Les Hite.

ctx.x: Well, he always played a one-finger piano, so he just jumped --
And then Lawrence, you see, Lawrence made a record that nobody knew about way back there, I think about 1930, * actually 'Memories of You'; Song of the Islands, made earlier * get Hamp!
